Trace, implement and test: leetcode1003 check if word is valid after substitutions stack

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    bool isValid(string s) {
        string stk; // 用string模拟栈
        for (auto& c: s) {
            stk += c;
            if (stk.size() >= 3 && stk.substr(stk.size() - 3) == "abc")
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
                    stk.pop_back();
            }
        }
        return stk.empty();
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    string s = "abcabcababcc";
    auto res = sol.isValid(s);
    cout << (res ? "True" : "False") << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
